tasks.title: Add icon.source field to IconConfig + parsers
tasks.description: Add `source` field to IconConfig struct and update Lua/JSON parsers to read it. Keep backwards compat with existing icns_path/ico_path/png_path.

tasks.title: Vendor stb_image.h + stb_image_write.h
tasks.description: Download stb_image.h and stb_image_write.h to thirdparty/stb/. These are single-file headers used to decode PNG/JPEG to RGBA and encode RGBA to PNG.

tasks.title: Add lunasvg dependency via CMake FetchContent
tasks.description: Add lunasvg as a build dependency in xmake.lua for SVG→RGBA rasterization. LunaSVG is an MIT-licensed C++ SVG rendering library.

tasks.title: Create icon_gen.h with public API
tasks.description: Declare format detection, SVG/PNG/JPEG loading, PNG encoding, ICNS/ICO packers, Linux PNG writer. New file at src/icon_gen.h.

tasks.title: Create icon_gen.cpp implementation
tasks.description: Implement format detection, SVG rendering via lunasvg, PNG/JPEG decoding via stb_image, PNG encoding via stb_image_write, ICNS/ICO binary packers, Linux PNG directory writer.

tasks.title: Wire generateIcons into bundle pipeline
tasks.description: Replace the simple icon copy in assembleBundle() with call to generateIcons(). If source is set and generation succeeds, use generated paths. Fall back to existing icns_path/ico_path/png_path for backwards compat.

tasks.title: Update xmake.lua with new dependencies
tasks.description: Add add_requires("lunasvg") and add_includedirs for stb. Update the coconut target to link lunasvg and include stb headers. Also add icon_gen.cpp to the source list.
